question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Be at a crossroads

options.text: To make a very important decision
To have taken the wrong road

solution:
The correct answer is **"To make a very important decision."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• **"To be at a crossroads"** is an idiomatic expression that means to be at a point in one's life or a situation where a decision or choice between two or more options is imminent. (किसी के जीवन में एक बिंदु पर या ऐसी स्थिति में होना जहां दो या दो से अधिक विकल्पों के बीच निर्णय या विकल्प आसन्न हो)
 
• It suggests a critical moment where one must choose a path or make a significant decision that will shape the future.
 
• Being at a crossroads implies uncertainty about which direction to take and the need to make a crucial choice.
 
 
• **Example**: *After completing his degree, John found himself **at a crossroads**__ in his career.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
